name: REINFORCED MIRROR-VISOR
text: Friendly Exaction Squad operatives ignore changes that would lower their APL, and enemy weapons have no Shock against them.

name: MANACLES
text: When an enemy would Fall Back while alone in a friendly Exaction Squad operative's control range, roll two D6 (one if the enemy has more Wounds): on any 4+ it cannot Fall Back, and this cannot be used again this turning point.

name: STROBING PHOSPHOR-LUMEN
text: When an enemy shoots, fights or retaliates against a friendly Exaction Squad operative within 2 inches of it, attack dice showing 1 cannot be re-rolled.

name: SPECIAL ISSUE SHELLS
text: Up to twice per turning point, when a friendly Exaction Squad operative Shoots with a shotgun or shotpistol, the weapon gains Saturate, or Piercing 1 against a target with a 3+ or better Save, or Torrent 1 inch with at most one secondary target, until the end of the action.
